comparison: Perfect agreement. Both evaluations find the smNG2-P cell line characterization well-supported, including validation of single integration, pluripotency markers, off-target analysis, and karyotyping (C22-C35, C66-C67). Both rate as SUPPORTED.

Perfect agreement. Both evaluations find the clonal isolation protocols and genotype validation well-supported (C24, C44-C47, C76, C79-C81). Both acknowledge the careful documentation of diverse genotypes and rate as SUPPORTED.

Significant disagreement. OpenEval rates endogenous tagging characterization as SUPPORTED (C2, C23, C36-C43, C68-C72), while peer reviewers rate as UNCERTAIN due to lack of quantification, insufficient replication information, and absence of orthogonal validation (e.g., antibody co-staining). Peer reviewers also note low fluorescence intensity concerns (C73 not in peer result).

Major disagreement. OpenEval rates CARE image restoration as SUPPORTED with only minor speculation concerns (C3, C50-C54, C84-C86), while peer reviewers rate as UNCERTAIN with significant concerns about potential AI-introduced artifacts, inadequate validation testing, and loss of biologically relevant information.

Agreement on background claims. Both evaluations find the literature-based background and contextual information well-supported by citations (C1, C4-C21 in OpenEval; subset plus C65, C94-C95 in peer review). Both rate as SUPPORTED.

Partial overlap with different scope. OpenEval R5 focuses on cytokinesis measurements (C55-C63, C87-C88) rated SUPPORTED. Peer R6 includes these claims plus mechanistic interpretations (C89-C93), all rated SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers accept both the measurements and interpretations despite CARE methodology concerns raised elsewhere.

Disagreement on certainty level. OpenEval rates mechanistic interpretations about cytokinesis as UNCERTAIN (C64, C89-C93), noting they are speculative and correlative. Peer reviewers include these claims in their SUPPORTED evaluation (R6), accepting the interpretations alongside the measurements.

Disagreement on protein localization validation. OpenEval rates claims about proper protein localization as SUPPORTED (C48, C82-C83). Peer R4 rates related localization claims (C49, C73, C82-C83) as UNCERTAIN, emphasizing lack of orthogonal validation via antibody co-staining.

Agreement on minor findings. Both evaluations find the observation about marker expression variability (C74-C75) supported by data and citations. Both rate as SUPPORTED, though peer review groups with other minor claims (C48, C77-C78, C96).

Disagreement on speculation. OpenEval rates explanations for genotypic diversity as UNCERTAIN (C77-C78), noting they are explicitly speculative. Peer reviewers include these in SUPPORTED evaluation (R8), not challenging the speculative interpretations.

Partial overlap on significance claims. OpenEval R10 addresses future potential and significance (C94-C96) rated SUPPORTED. Peer R7 includes C94-C95 among background/contextual claims also rated SUPPORTED. Minor overlap with peer R8 on C96.

Minimal overlap. OpenEval R10 includes conclusion about future applications (C96) rated SUPPORTED. Peer R8 also includes C96 among supporting observations rated SUPPORTED, though grouped with different claims (C48, C74-C75, C77-C78).
